tool_input.command:
hops sql --no-verify --catalog delta --schema mlpab3e66fb_featurestore --limit 0 --json \
"WITH fin AS (SELECT row_id, status, balance, updated_at FROM accountsf7b5f8_1), \
 latest AS (SELECT row_id, max(updated_at) AS mx FROM accountsf7b5f8_stage_1 GROUP BY row_id) \
 SELECT \
   (SELECT count(*) FROM fin) AS final_rows, \
   (SELECT count(distinct row_id) FROM fin) AS final_distinct, \
   (SELECT count(*) FROM fin JOIN latest ON fin.row_id=latest.row_id AND fin.updated_at=latest.mx) AS matches_latest" \
2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'final_rows|final_distinct|matches_latest'
tool_input.description: Verify final table is one-row-per-id at latest revision
